name: Electrical and Computer Engineering
notes: Five 4-credit ECE courses. The page gives five recommended five-course programs of study (Digital Audio and Music; Integrated Circuits; Waves, Fields, and Devices; Signals and Communications; Robotics), and students may instead arrange an individualized program with an ECE advisor and the approval of the ECE undergraduate committee.
Because an individualized program is explicitly allowed, the five named tracks are modeled as a track choice rather than as the only option.

requirementGroups.label: Five-course program of study
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The ECE minor gives students the opportunity to design a flexible program of study to achieve either breadth or depth ... normally requiring the equivalent of five 4-credit hour courses in ECE. Recommended programs of study: Digital Audio and Music - ECE 113, ECE 114, ECE 140, ECE 223, ECE 240; Integrated Circuits - ECE 112, ECE 113, ECE 221, ECE 222, ECE 260; Waves, Fields, and Devices - ECE 113, ECE 221, ECE 222, ECE 223, ECE 230; Signals and Communications - ECE 113, ECE 114, ECE 240, ECE 245, ECE 246; Robotics - ECE 112, ECE 113, ECE 114, ECE 216, ECE 217
